title: Integrality of weak limits in top dimension (Remark 3.12)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1 and U ⊆ ℝⁿ open. If T_j, T ∈ D_n(U), every T_j is integer multiplicity, sup_j (M_W(T_j) + M_W(∂T_j)) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U, and T_j ⇀ T, then T is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))), IsOpen U → ∀ (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Tj j)) → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (⨆ j, ((Tj j).massOn W + (Tj j).boundary.massOn W)) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Tj T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
